house.description: Commissioner of children, youth, and families funding provided to create and implement technology portals to connect individuals with support systems; and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Children and Families Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to children; appropriating money for the commissioner of children, youth, and families to create and implement technology portals to connect individuals with support systems.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CONNECTING TECHNOLOGY SERVICES. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families to create and implement technology portals on the Department of Children, Youth, and Families website that connect vulnerable children and families with community support systems, including but not limited to churches, nonprofit organizations, and civic organizations. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children; appropriating money for the commissioner of children, youth, and families to create and implement technology portals to connect individuals with support systems.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CONNECTING TECHNOLOGY SERVICES.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families to create and implement technology portals on the Department of Children, Youth, and Families website that connect vulnerable children and families with community support systems, including but not limited to churches, nonprofit organizations, and civic organizations. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families to create and implement technology portals on the Department of Children, Youth, and Families website that connect vulnerable children and families with community support systems, including but not limited to churches, nonprofit organizations, and civic organizations. This is a onetime appropriation.
